g.text: steps 2-5 are pure quaternion arithmetic, any p (tested at 61 and 127 bits)

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: hybrid (smooth d = l^e): guess an l^e1 prefix as sub-ideals after step 1, run 2-5 on the rest, compose before 6
